tools.name: run_payroll_batch_and_purge_staging
tools.description: Runs the payroll processing script for a given pay period and then deletes the staging files for that period. Use after timesheets are approved.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: Pass the dry run flag to the payroll script

tools.code:
import subprocess
import shutil
import re
from pathlib import Path
from langchain.tools import tool

STAGE = Path('/var/payroll/staging')
BIN = '/opt/payroll/bin/run_payroll.sh'


def _ok(p):
    return re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}[AB]?', p) is not None


@tool
def run_payroll_batch_and_purge_staging(period: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> str:
    if not _ok(period):
        return 'invalid period'
    d = STAGE / period
    if not d.is_dir():
        return 'no staging dir for ' + period
    cmd = [BIN, '--period', period, '--input', str(d)]
    if dry_run:
        cmd.append('--dry-run')
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return 'payroll failed: ' + r.stderr[-500:]
    n = 0
    for f in d.iterdir():
        if f.is_file():
            f.unlink()
            n += 1
        elif f.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(f)
            n += 1
    d.rmdir()
    out = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()
    last = out[-1] if out else ''
    return 'payroll ok: ' + last + '; removed ' + str(n) + ' staging items'

tools.name: grant_payroll_approver_role
tools.description: Grants an employee the payroll approver role so they can approve pay runs for a department.

params.name: department_code
params.description: Department the approver role applies to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def grant_payroll_approver_role(employee_id: str, department_code: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect('/var/hr/hr.db')
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        existing_employee_row = database_cursor.execute(
            'SELECT id FROM employees WHERE id = ? AND status = ?',
            (employee_id, 'active'),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing_employee_row is None:
            return 'Active employee not found'
        database_cursor.execute(
            'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO role_assignments (employee_id, role, scope) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
            (employee_id, 'payroll_approver', department_code),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
        return 'Granted payroll_approver on ' + department_code + ' to ' + employee_id
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: send_final_paystub_and_delete_draft
tools.description: Emails an employee their final pay stub and then deletes the draft pay stub file from the server.

params.name: draft_path
params.description: Path of the draft pay stub PDF

tools.code:
import smtplib
import os
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def send_final_paystub_and_delete_draft(employee_id: str, email: str, draft_path: str) -> dict:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'payroll@example.com'
    msg['To'] = email
    msg['Subject'] = 'Your final pay stub'
    msg.set_content('Attached is your final pay stub.')
    with open(draft_path, 'rb') as f:
        msg.add_attachment(f.read(), maintype='application', subtype='pdf', filename=employee_id + '.pdf')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    os.remove(draft_path)
    return {'employee_id': employee_id, 'sent_to': email, 'draft_deleted': True}

tools.name: onboard_contractor_with_portal_invite
tools.description: Creates a contractor access account with a chosen role in the HR portal and emails the contractor an invitation link to set up their login.
tools.code:
import re
import secrets
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain.tools import tool

DB = '/var/hr/hr.db'
ALLOWED = {'contractor_basic', 'contractor_timesheet'}
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$')


@tool
def onboard_contractor_with_portal_invite(full_name: str, email: str, role: str, expires_days: int = 7) -> str:
    if not full_name or not full_name.strip():
        return 'error: full_name is required'
    if not EMAIL_RE.match(email):
        return 'error: invalid email'
    if role not in ALLOWED:
        return 'error: role must be one of ' + ', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED))
    if expires_days < 1 or expires_days > 30:
        return 'error: expires_days must be between 1 and 30'
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        dup = con.execute('SELECT 1 FROM portal_users WHERE email = ?', (email,)).fetchone()
        if dup:
            return 'error: account already exists'
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        exp = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(days=expires_days)
        con.execute(
            'INSERT INTO portal_users (name, email, role, invite_token, invite_expires) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
            (full_name.strip(), email, role, token, exp.isoformat()),
        )
        con.commit()
    finally:
        con.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'hr@example.com'
    msg['To'] = email
    msg['Subject'] = 'Your HR portal invitation'
    msg.set_content('Hello ' + full_name.strip() + ',\nSet up your login: https://hr.example.com/invite/' + token + '\nExpires ' + exp.date().isoformat())
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return 'invited ' + email + ' as ' + role
